name: Z-order Index Remapping for Binary Tree Hierarchy
definition: A method to map a Z-order (Lebesgue) 1D index to a hierarchical out-of-core binary tree index, allowing efficient traversal of rectilinear grids by determining the element's level and local index within that level.
summary: Z-order Index Remapping converts a 1D Z-order index into a hierarchical binary tree index using bitwise operations, enabling efficient out-of-core traversal of rectilinear grids by determining element levels and local offsets.
